quandoUsar: Section switching inside a card or page where the switch itself deserves attention: the active pill travels, stretching toward the new tab.
A few tabs with short labels whose panels have different heights: the content area animates the height from one panel to the other.
quandoEvitar: Use `tabs` when you need to compose triggers and panels freely or keep panels mounted; here only the active panel exists in the DOM.
Use `segmented-control` when the choice only changes a mode or filter and there is no associated panel.
Use `expandable-tabs` when the tabs are icons and the space only fits the label of the active tab.

teclado.acao: Select the next or previous tab, wrapping around at the ends and skipping disabled ones; selection follows focus.
Select the first or last enabled tab.
Enters the list at the active tab and then moves to the panel, which is focusable.

acessibilidade: Follows the tabs pattern: `role="tablist"` with `aria-label` coming from `label`, tabs with `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`, and a `role="tabpanel"` panel linked by `aria-labelledby`.
Uses roving tabindex (only the active tab is in the Tab order), and the colored copy of the row that forms the pill is `aria-hidden`.
The default `label` is “Sections”, in English; pass the real name of the tab set.
movimento: The pill is a clip (`clip-path`) of a copy of the row in the highlight color: the leading edge arrives first with a fast spring and the trailing edge follows with a slower one, which stretches the pill.

While stretched it thins (up to 5 px less at top and bottom) and gets squarer corners, and returns to the pill shape on arrival; the panel exits and enters sliding 36 px in the direction of travel, with the height on a spring.
With “reduce motion” on, the pill jumps to the new tab and the panel and height change instantly.
responsivo: If the row of tabs is wider than the available space, it scrolls horizontally with the scrollbar hidden; below 26rem of viewport the tabs' side padding shrinks.
desempenho: The pill animates only `clip-path` from two motion values, with no per-frame layout; labels and icons are rendered twice because of the colored copy.
notasIA: Import the named component `MorphingTabs`; the file's default export is the preview with an example card.
The API is an array: `tabs` with `id`, `label`, `icon`, `content`, and `disabled`; control it with `value` and `onValueChange` or use `defaultValue`.
Because only the active panel stays mounted, local state inside `content` is lost when switching tabs; and the list's 4 px inset in the CSS must match the component's `INSET` constant.
